about: Cross-app colour-name contract (fixture colours only). The intake shop-tools desk writes a colour name into the same catalog.v1 Blob the sell shop reads. shopStores is true when the shop keeps that name: sassy-closet-shop/lib/colors.ts isStoredColorWord drops a bare hex and a 'Color #' placeholder, and parseProductColor then persists an empty name (the customer page falls back to 'Color 1'). Both app tests read this file: the intake test pins that the desk refuses a name it would only lose, the shop test pins the rule that decides it. No catalog, price, or seed row is changed.

rows.name: Color 1
rows.case: literal words that are not a # placeholder
